title: UOD Instance Demo File Schema
description: JSON Schema for files under instances/demo/. Each file is a curated, frozen set of example instances for one layer (L1 or one L2 industry extension or one L3 enterprise). Real (harvested) instance data lives in the uod-backend Postgres database, NOT in Git — this schema only governs the public demo subset.

layer.description: Layer this demo set belongs to (must match the canonical class-definition file's layer id)

source_file.description: Repo-relative path to the class-definition JSON these instances illustrate

instances.description: Curated demo instances. Real production data goes in the backend DB, not here.

id.description: snake_case identifier, unique within instances/demo/ tree

type.description: PascalCase class id; MUST be non-abstract (validated by scripts/validate_instances.py against the class-definition JSON)

data.description: Free-form attribute payload. Each key SHOULD correspond to an attribute defined for `type` (or one of its ancestors) in the class-definition layer.

source.description: Provenance: where did this instance come from?

source_url.description: Citation URL — required for any source other than 'manual'

source_id.description: External identifier in the source system (e.g., Wikidata Q-id, SEC CIK)

confidence.description: Mapping confidence: 1.0 for human-curated, lower for auto-extracted

status.description: Lifecycle. All instances in instances/demo/ MUST be 'accepted' (curated). Candidates / rejections live in the backend DB.

harvested_at.description: When this instance entered the system (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-05-26T00:00:00Z)

verified_by.description: GitHub login of the curator, or 'curated' for legacy migrated entries

allOf.description: Must have at least one of label_en or label_zh
